questions.question: Explain how investment in education and training can improve the UK's economic performance.
questions.correctAnswer: Education and training improve human capital: workers become more productive, more adaptable (reducing structural unemployment), and more innovative. A better-educated workforce attracts foreign investment and increases GDP per capita.

questions.question: Describe the potential advantages and disadvantages of privatisation.
questions.correctAnswer: Advantages: introduces competition and profit motive (improving efficiency), reduces government spending, raises revenue from sale. Disadvantages: natural monopolies may exploit consumers, job losses as private firms cut costs, essential services may become unaffordable.

questions.question: Evaluate whether supply-side policies are more effective than demand-side policies for long-term economic growth.
questions.correctAnswer: Supply-side policies increase productive capacity (shifting LRAS right) — permanent effects on potential output. Demand-side policies boost actual output but cannot increase potential. For long-term growth, supply-side is more effective.
